verdict.rationale: Data portability is a fair question for a SaaS creative platform like Kling AI, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack documents no bulk data export, account export, open-format archive, or offboarding capability. The RESTful API and MCP/CLI are generation interfaces, not a documented export feature, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
